title: Valid Parentheses
prompt: Given a string `s` containing only the characters `(`, `)`, `{`, `}`, `[`, and `]`, determine if the string is valid. A string is valid if every open bracket is closed by the same type of bracket, and brackets are closed in the correct order.
constraints: s consists only of the characters '()[]{}'
hints: The most recently opened bracket must be the next one closed — that's a last-in-first-out order.
Push opening brackets onto a stack. When you see a closing bracket, it must match the top of the stack.
If the stack is empty when you need to pop, or a mismatch occurs, or the stack isn't empty at the end, the string is invalid.

solution.approach: Use a stack. Push each opening bracket. On a closing bracket, pop the stack and check it matches the expected opener — if the stack is empty or it doesn't match, the string is invalid immediately. At the end, the string is valid only if the stack is empty (no unclosed openers remain).
